        <script>
          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================
   VIMEO VIDEO
========================= */

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

  player.ready().then(() => {

    togglePlayIcons(true);
    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

    player.getPaused().then(paused => {

      if (paused) {

        player.play();
        togglePlayIcons(true);

      } else {

        player.pause();
        togglePlayIcons(false);

      }

    });

  });

  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — Vimeo");

    player.getMuted().then(muted => {
      console.log("[MuteBtn] Vimeo — isMuted before toggle:", muted);

      if (muted) {

        player.setMuted(false);
        toggleMuteIcons(false);

      } else {

        player.setMuted(true);
        toggleMuteIcons(true);

      }

    });

  });

}
                /* =========================
         HUBSPOT VIDEO (VIDYARD)
      ========================= */

                else if (hsVideo && window.vidyardEmbed) {

                  const uuid = hsVideo.dataset.vidyardUuid;

                  window.vidyardEmbed.api.getPlayersByUUID(uuid)[0]?.then(player => {

                    togglePlayIcons(true);
                    toggleMuteIcons(true);

                    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                      if (player.isPaused()) {

                        player.play();
                        togglePlayIcons(true);

                      } else {

                        player.pause();
                        togglePlayIcons(false);

                      }

                    });

                    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — HubSpot/Vidyard — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                      if (player.isMuted()) {

                        player.unmute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(false);

                      } else {

                        player.mute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(true);

                      }

                    });

                  });

                }

                showControls();

              });

            }

            /* ------------------------
     Safe initialization
  ------------------------ */

            if (typeof pwr !== "undefined" && pwr.dom) {

              pwr.dom.ready(initAutoplayVideos);

            } else {

              document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAutoplayVideos);

            }

          })();
        </script>

          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================
   VIMEO VIDEO
========================= */

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

  player.ready().then(() => {

    togglePlayIcons(true);
    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

    player.getPaused().then(paused => {

      if (paused) {

        player.play();
        togglePlayIcons(true);

      } else {

        player.pause();
        togglePlayIcons(false);

      }

    });

  });

  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — Vimeo");

    player.getMuted().then(muted => {
      console.log("[MuteBtn] Vimeo — isMuted before toggle:", muted);

      if (muted) {

        player.setMuted(false);
        toggleMuteIcons(false);

      } else {

        player.setMuted(true);
        toggleMuteIcons(true);

      }

    });

  });

}
                /* =========================
         HUBSPOT VIDEO (VIDYARD)
      ========================= */

                else if (hsVideo && window.vidyardEmbed) {

                  const uuid = hsVideo.dataset.vidyardUuid;

                  window.vidyardEmbed.api.getPlayersByUUID(uuid)[0]?.then(player => {

                    togglePlayIcons(true);
                    toggleMuteIcons(true);

                    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                      if (player.isPaused()) {

                        player.play();
                        togglePlayIcons(true);

                      } else {

                        player.pause();
                        togglePlayIcons(false);

                      }

                    });

                    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — HubSpot/Vidyard — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                      if (player.isMuted()) {

                        player.unmute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(false);

                      } else {

                        player.mute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(true);

                      }

                    });

                  });

                }

                showControls();

              });

            }

            /* ------------------------
     Safe initialization
  ------------------------ */

            if (typeof pwr !== "undefined" && pwr.dom) {

              pwr.dom.ready(initAutoplayVideos);

            } else {

              document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAutoplayVideos);

            }

          })();

        <script>
          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================
   VIMEO VIDEO
========================= */

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

  player.ready().then(() => {

    togglePlayIcons(true);
    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

    player.getPaused().then(paused => {

      if (paused) {

        player.play();
        togglePlayIcons(true);

      } else {

        player.pause();
        togglePlayIcons(false);

      }

    });

  });

  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — Vimeo");

    player.getMuted().then(muted => {
      console.log("[MuteBtn] Vimeo — isMuted before toggle:", muted);

      if (muted) {

        player.setMuted(false);
        toggleMuteIcons(false);

      } else {

        player.setMuted(true);
        toggleMuteIcons(true);

      }

    });

  });

}
                /* =========================
         HUBSPOT VIDEO (VIDYARD)
      ========================= */

                else if (hsVideo && window.vidyardEmbed) {

                  const uuid = hsVideo.dataset.vidyardUuid;

                  window.vidyardEmbed.api.getPlayersByUUID(uuid)[0]?.then(player => {

                    togglePlayIcons(true);
                    toggleMuteIcons(true);

                    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                      if (player.isPaused()) {

                        player.play();
                        togglePlayIcons(true);

                      } else {

                        player.pause();
                        togglePlayIcons(false);

                      }

                    });

                    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — HubSpot/Vidyard — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                      if (player.isMuted()) {

                        player.unmute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(false);

                      } else {

                        player.mute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(true);

                      }

                    });

                  });

                }

                showControls();

              });

            }

            /* ------------------------
     Safe initialization
  ------------------------ */

            if (typeof pwr !== "undefined" && pwr.dom) {

              pwr.dom.ready(initAutoplayVideos);

            } else {

              document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAutoplayVideos);

            }

          })();
        </script>

        <script>
          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================
   VIMEO VIDEO
========================= */

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

  player.ready().then(() => {

    togglePlayIcons(true);
    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

    player.getPaused().then(paused => {

      if (paused) {

        player.play();
        togglePlayIcons(true);

      } else {

        player.pause();
        togglePlayIcons(false);

      }

    });

  });

  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — Vimeo");

    player.getMuted().then(muted => {
      console.log("[MuteBtn] Vimeo — isMuted before toggle:", muted);

      if (muted) {

        player.setMuted(false);
        toggleMuteIcons(false);

      } else {

        player.setMuted(true);
        toggleMuteIcons(true);

      }

    });

  });

}
                /* =========================
         HUBSPOT VIDEO (VIDYARD)
      ========================= */

                else if (hsVideo && window.vidyardEmbed) {

                  const uuid = hsVideo.dataset.vidyardUuid;

                  window.vidyardEmbed.api.getPlayersByUUID(uuid)[0]?.then(player => {

                    togglePlayIcons(true);
                    toggleMuteIcons(true);

                    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                      if (player.isPaused()) {

                        player.play();
                        togglePlayIcons(true);

                      } else {

                        player.pause();
                        togglePlayIcons(false);

                      }

                    });

                    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — HubSpot/Vidyard — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                      if (player.isMuted()) {

                        player.unmute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(false);

                      } else {

                        player.mute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(true);

                      }

                    });

                  });

                }

                showControls();

              });

            }

            /* ------------------------
     Safe initialization
  ------------------------ */

            if (typeof pwr !== "undefined" && pwr.dom) {

              pwr.dom.ready(initAutoplayVideos);

            } else {

              document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAutoplayVideos);

            }

          })();
        </script>

          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================

========================= */

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

  player.ready().then(() => {

    togglePlayIcons(true);
    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

    player.getPaused().then(paused => {

      if (paused) {

        player.play();
        togglePlayIcons(true);

      } else {

        player.pause();
        togglePlayIcons(false);

      }

    });

  });

  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — Vimeo");

    player.getMuted().then(muted => {
      console.log("[MuteBtn] Vimeo — isMuted before toggle:", muted);

      if (muted) {

        player.setMuted(false);
        toggleMuteIcons(false);

      } else {

        player.setMuted(true);
        toggleMuteIcons(true);

      }

    });

  });

}
                /* =========================

                else if (hsVideo && window.vidyardEmbed) {

                    togglePlayIcons(true);

                    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                      if (player.isPaused()) {

                        player.play();
                        togglePlayIcons(true);

                      } else {

                        player.pause();
                        togglePlayIcons(false);

                      }

                    });

                    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — HubSpot/Vidyard — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                      if (player.isMuted()) {

                        player.unmute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(false);

                      } else {

                        player.mute();
                        toggleMuteIcons(true);

                      }

                    });

                  });

                }

                showControls();

              });

            }

            /* ------------------------

              pwr.dom.ready(initAutoplayVideos);

            } else {

              document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initAutoplayVideos);

            }

          })();

          (function () {

            function initAutoplayVideos() {

              const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-pwr-autoplay]");
              if (!wrappers.length) return;

              wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {

                const htmlVideo = wrapper.querySelector("video");
                const iframe = wrapper.querySelector("iframe");
                const hsVideo = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__inline-video--hs");

                const playBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__autoplay-play-btn");
                const muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__mute-btn");

                if (!playBtn || !muteBtn) return;

                const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__play-icon");
                const pauseIcon = playBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__pause-icon");

                const volOn = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-on");
                const volOff = muteBtn.querySelector(".pwr-sec-video__volume-off");

                let hideTimer;

                /* ------------------------
         Controls visibility
      ------------------------ */

                function showControls() {

                  playBtn.style.opacity = "1";
                  muteBtn.style.opacity = "1";

                  clearTimeout(hideTimer);

                  hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    playBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                    muteBtn.style.opacity = "0";
                  }, 3000);

                }

                wrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", showControls);
                wrapper.addEventListener("mousemove", showControls);

                function togglePlayIcons(isPlaying) {

                  playIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "none" : "block";
                  pauseIcon.style.display = isPlaying ? "block" : "none";

                }

                function toggleMuteIcons(isMuted) {

                  volOff.style.display = isMuted ? "block" : "none";
                  volOn.style.display = isMuted ? "none" : "block";

                }

                /* =========================
         HTML5 VIDEO
      ========================= */

                if (htmlVideo) {

                  togglePlayIcons(true);
                  toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                  playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                    if (htmlVideo.paused) {
                      htmlVideo.play();
                      togglePlayIcons(true);
                    } else {
                      htmlVideo.pause();
                      togglePlayIcons(false);
                    }

                  });

                  muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — htmlVideo — muted before toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);

                    htmlVideo.muted = !htmlVideo.muted;
                    toggleMuteIcons(htmlVideo.muted);

                    console.log("[MuteBtn] muted after toggle:", htmlVideo.muted);
                  });

                }

                /* =========================
   YOUTUBE VIDEO
========================= */

                else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("youtube")) {

                  function initYT() {

                    const player = new YT.Player(iframe, {

                      events: {
                        onReady: function () {

                          togglePlayIcons(true);
                          toggleMuteIcons(true);

                          playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {

                            const state = player.getPlayerState();

                            if (state === 1) {
                              player.pauseVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.playVideo();
                              togglePlayIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                          muteBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            console.log("[MuteBtn] click detected — YouTube — isMuted:", player.isMuted());

                            if (player.isMuted()) {
                              player.unMute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(false);
                            } else {
                              player.mute();
                              toggleMuteIcons(true);
                            }

                          });

                        }
                      }

                    });

                  }

                  if (typeof YT === "undefined") {

                    const tag = document.createElement("script");
                    tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
                    document.head.appendChild(tag);

                    window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = initYT;

                  } else {

                    initYT();

                  }

                }

/* =========================

else if (iframe && iframe.src.includes("vimeo")) {

  player.ready().then(() => {

    toggleMuteIcons(true);

  });

  });
